items.title: DeepSeek updates: Oct 17, 2026
items.summary: ​ Opening up the in-house search API ​ DeepSeek's web and API search capabilities are powered by our in-house DeepSeek search engine, which reliably handles hundreds of millions of search requests from around the world every day. DeepSeek Search is an AI-native general-purpose search engine that indexes hundreds of billions of web pages, supports multilingual search, and returns highly relevant, authoritative, and timely results in real time. It filters SEO spam, GEO manipulation, and low-quality AIGC through strict detection mechanisms, ensuring authoritative and trustworthy information for users and LLMs. For usage details, see the Search & Fetch guide . DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 Update ​ DeepSeek V4.1 Flash has been upgraded to DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017. The official web and APP models have also been updated to the new version.
